portable.definition: The downloaded archives execute the documented offline procedure on all six supported targets, with baseline x86 ISA enforcement and no runtime toolchain or service dependency.

competitive.definition: A controlled public comparison against a comparable local system is available for the same retrieval mode, corpus, hardware class, and resource budget.

state_of_the_art.definition: A top-tier public quality result and a documented Pareto advantage in local latency, footprint, or portability are both present.

comparisons.reason: No retained same-hardware exact-search comparison is available.
